header.description: Roofnet-inspired 38-node wireless mesh. Node count follows the 38-node ExOR/Roofnet testbed; links are an explicitly declared deterministic emulation because official link matrices are not available from the inspected official pages.

official_basis.node_count: 38-node Roofnet testbed reported in ExOR/SIGCOMM measurement paper
official_basis.mesh_context: Roofnet/MobiCom paper reports a rooftop 802.11b multi-hop mesh with average route about 3 hops
official_basis.missing_official_data: machine-readable loss/throughput matrix not present in inspected official pages

emulation_rules.placement: uniform deterministic placement in a 2km x 2km square to emulate unplanned placement
emulation_rules.radius_selection: chosen so the connected graph average shortest path is close to Roofnet reported average hop count about 3
emulation_rules.edge_capacity_rule: capacity=1.0 normalized service unit on all wireless links
emulation_rules.p_on_rule: distance-decay reliability model p_on=clip(0.92 - 0.55*(d/radius)^2 + deterministic jitter, 0.08, 0.98)
emulation_rules.dynamic_edge_rule: all emulated wireless links are dynamic

metadata.capacity_model: node and directed-arc capacities i.i.d. uniform on {2,...,10}, seed 20260719
metadata.dynamic_model: only arcs incident to source/sink endpoints are dynamic (p_on=0.8)

origin: Recipe reconstructed from released coordinates/metadata and historical capacity/access scripts; verified against the existing input.
